# Paired measurement exercise

Synthetic input: five sample identities, before and after in mg/L. Describe the
complete-pair mean change; identify missing observations and preserve the input.
Do not impute a value or claim statistical significance, causal benefit, or a
validated scientific method. Produce a JSON result, report, reproduction command
and independent check. Fail on duplicate identity, nonfinite numeric data,
mixed units, or no complete pair. This fixture has four complete pairs and one
missing after measurement. The expected mean paired change is 3 mg/L.

Method references: the catalog's verification-before-completion (general) and
statistical-analysis (research). Record exact IDs, revisions and content hashes
from the catalog and compare with public acquisition receipts. No model is
required for this deterministic preparation. Real-model acceptance must run as
an explicit opt-in with the same inputs and independent checks; fixture provider
responses and hand-authored scripts are not evidence of model research quality.

Deliver report and result as ordinary workspace artifacts. Notebook attachment
and independent human scientific acceptance remain separate follow-up steps.
